# JEE Console

> A focus timer and consistency tracker built for JEE aspirants — tracks five curriculum subjects, logs deep-work sessions, and surfaces a daily consistency quotient.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Countdown to JEE, consistency quotient, and 28-day focus history.
- [Focus](/focus): Deep focus timer with ambient audio and urge surfer.
- [Tracks](/tracks): Curriculum tracks and chapter progress for Physics, Chemistry, and Math.
- [Override Matrix](/matrix): Administrative view to manually set chapter completion.
- [Manual Log](/log): Record study blocks completed offline.
